messages:
maria_finance: Heads up — got an invoice spike flagged by the daily job. Looks like ~18k USD in spot/preemptible GPU charges split between us-west1 and europe-west1 for the same job id. Anyone seen this pattern before?

sophie_eng: that's odd, did the job trigger a cross-region retry? @marcus_infra do we have any autoscale/fallback routing that could move pods between regions?

marcus_infra: not supposed to for customer workloads. Routing policy is region-strict unless we hit capacity and then we only burst to same CLOUD_REGION pool. I'll pull the allocation logs.

cost-bot: Automated alert — cost-anomaly detected (job=job-8a3c, delta=+17,820 USD, period=2026-03-22 00:00Z..2026-03-22 06:00Z). See /billing/alerts/246789.

angela_ops: forwarding the invoice snippet from the vendor — see attached in the billing portal. The vendor shows two separate line items with the same VM id but different zones: us-west1-b and europe-west1-b.

maria_finance: here's the quick grep I ran on our internal usage table:

```
SELECT job_id, region, sum(usd) FROM usage_lines
WHERE job_id = 'job-8a3c' GROUP BY job_id, region;
-- results:
-- job-8a3c | us-west1 | 11840.00
-- job-8a3c | europe-west1 | 5950.00
```

sophie_eng: hmm. The job code is single-region; but we recently rolled out a new dataset fetch step that forks a short-lived prefetcher service. Could the prefetcher be misconfigured to spawn in both regions?

marcus_infra: I checked the routing logs. There's a failing endpoint in us-west1 around 00:37Z, which triggered a retry policy that SHOULD be local-only, but I see an unexpected "fallback-global" decision:

```
2026-03-22T00:37:12Z decision=retry fallback=fallback-global reason=capacity_check_failed
job=job-8a3c trace=... node=cluster-proxy-3
```

angela_ops: vendor support replied: "We see compute_id XY-987 used in europe-west1 and us-west1. Could be billing reconciliation grouping by compute image rather than instance. We'll escalate."

maria_finance: Reaction: :thinking_face: If vendor groups by image, that could double-count if we launched identical instance names in two zones. But why would same compute_id show up in two regions?

sophie_eng: possible theory: the prefetcher containers are built from the same image and we used an image tag that included a stale node-affinity label. The builder pipeline might have published the image with an org-wide tag 'prefetcher:latest', and infra pooled it to both regions. I'll check the deployment manifest PR.

marcus_infra: Action: I've pulled the proxy traces and started a deeper look at the autoscaler decision tree. Early suspicion: the capacity healthcheck for the west cluster returned a transient error and our fallback policy erroneously marked the global fallback as allowed for that job class. I can revert that policy change from the last patch.

maria_finance: Can we confirm scope for chargeback? If it's a routing/config bug we should attribute costs to infra for a retro adjustment, otherwise to product team. We need a triage decision by EOD so finance can decide whether to request vendor credit.

angela_ops: vendor asked for a correlation file. @sophie_eng can you produce a mapping of instance_id -> region -> timestamp for that job window? They want CSV in the next 4 hours.

sophie_eng: on it. I'll dump from our orchestration logs and scrub PII.

marcus_infra: I'll open a configuration rollback PR to disable the fallback-global flag for ephemeral jobs — linking it here once ready.

cost-bot: Triage checklist added to ticket #BILL-246789: [ ] vendor correlation requested, [ ] infra rollback candidate, [ ] product confirm prefetcher multi-zone spawn. Owner=marcus_infra, due=2026-03-22T18:00Z.

maria_finance: Great. If vendor declines credit, finance will push for retro allocation to infra runbooks. I'll also throttle alerts so only >5k/regional anomalies hit paging.

sophie_eng: CSV exported and uploaded to /secure-shared/billing/correlations/job-8a3c-246789.csv (sensitive, access=finance+infra). Sample rows:

```
instance_id,region,timestamp
XY-987,us-west1,2026-03-22T00:36:55Z
XY-987,europe-west1,2026-03-22T00:38:04Z
```

angela_ops: vendor ack'd receipt and passed to their reconciliation team. They said preliminary view looks like double-counting; asking for full audit logs.

maria_finance: moving to owners: infra owns rollback and root cause, eng owns manifest fix, finance owns vendor negotiation. Will update billing ledger once we have vendor response. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

marcus_infra: PR opened: github.com/redwood/infra/PR/890 (disable fallback-global for ephemeral workloads). Rolling to staging now.

sophie_eng: I also opened a follow-up to pin prefetcher images by digest in our deployment pipeline to avoid accidental cross-region publication. PR link: github.com/redwood/prefetcher/PR/447

maria_finance: keeping this thread pinned for the billing audit. Last update from vendor expected by 2026-03-22T17:00Z."
